Noted on the minds 0.4.0 wire-compat snapshot that it also covers the minds 0.4.4 release, and extended its `SUPPORT_ENDS` to 2026-10-01 (0.4.4's release date plus the support window). The strictly-parsed connector response surface is unchanged between minds-v0.4.3 and minds-v0.4.4: the only `wire_types` change is the additive optional `ShareInfo.chrome_origin` field (default `None`), which adds no required field, and no new strict-parse call sites were added client-side. No new snapshot module is needed, and nothing was pruned (the 0.3.16 and 0.4.0 snapshots are both still in-window).
